lines.text: Many learners say: It's cold. Turn on the warmer.
Better: It's cold. Turn on the heater.
A machine that makes heat is a heater.
Heater! It's freezing. Can you turn on the heater?

data.wrong: It's cold. Turn on the warmer.
data.right: It's cold. Turn on the heater.
data.why: A machine that makes heat is a heater.

quiz.stem: It's freezing. Can you turn on the ___?

publish.title: Stop saying "warmer"? Say this instead
